payload.name: Zero-Shot Calls Are Never Dropped
payload.description: A model call that supplies intelligence is kept. A missing or empty answer is a failed call. Speed comes from batching, concurrency and reuse that keep every judgment, never from skipping the call.

principles.name: Do not drop intelligence
principles.description: Removing a judgment to save time silently lowers what the system understands.

principles.name: An empty answer is a failure
principles.description: An empty, missing or unparseable response carries no judgment and must not be read as one.

heuristics.condition: a stage reports success with no model output
heuristics.action: verify the stage was not given a silent default for an empty response

heuristics.condition: a prompt template drops instructions to fit
heuristics.action: stop and fix the fit by chunking; instructions are never the part that is dropped

decision_rules.name: Empty is a failed call
decision_rules.condition: a model response is empty, missing, unparseable or all-failed
decision_rules.outcome: record the failure, retry or await it, and fail or pause the stage; never substitute {}, [], a default or 'nothing found'

decision_rules.name: Keep the call
decision_rules.condition: a call is slow or costly and someone proposes skipping or shortcutting it
decision_rules.outcome: keep the call and shorten the time by batching several independent yes or no questions into one call, reusing stored analyses, or running independent calls concurrently, with each judgment still separate

decision_rules.name: Keep the vote semantics
decision_rules.outcome: preserve each question's own strength-N confirmation and the unanimity needed to drop, so batching never turns many judgments into one

decision_rules.name: Register a new call site
decision_rules.condition: a new zero-shot call is added
decision_rules.outcome: register it in the zero-shot call registry, the call route registry and the zero-shot expansion guide, with its prompt, route and failure handling
